original.statement: A new CRD usages.protection.crossplane.io/v1beta1 (kind Usage) has been added; operators managing CRDs separately from the release must install or update this CRD before upgrading.

decision.reason: The artifacts show that protection.crossplane.io_usages.yaml exists only in v2.0.0 [ev-147c26b74d68]. The v1.20.1 tree has a Usage CRD only under apiextensions.crossplane.io [ev-4cb106f172c6], and that CRD is still present in v2.0.0 [ev-a51a53aa04ee]. So this change adds a CRD; nothing existing is removed or must be migrated. The only stated condition is the generic note to install CRDs 'if you manage them separately from the release'. edge-from-version <2.0.0 matches every environment on this upgrade edge, so it is broader than that condition. No predicate can express how an operator manages CRDs, and no upstream text says anything fails, so the evidence supports no correct exposure condition.
